messages:
liam: FYI opened a docs PR to clarify model aliasing + fallback behavior and to add an SDK v4 snippet showing how to pin variants and fall back to quantized/CPU-friendly models. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9123 :eyes:

sara: Nice, can you call out Dedicated vs Hosted differences? We still get questions about latency guarantees when fallback fires.

liam: yep — added a short section under 'Serving behavior' and a note in the model-catalog compatibility table about SLA differences. Also added a tiny benchmark row showing median tail latency for fallback path.

jun: do we need to change any model cards? I assume Artemis13B needs a compatibility note for the quantized variant (artemis13b-q4) since it drops long-seq perf.

liam: good catch. I added an inline TODO in the PR to update Artemis13B card: call out seq ceiling and KV-cache impact.

maya: can you paste the SDK v4 snippet here? I'll port it into the migration guide and the quickstart.

liam: sure — here's the snippet I put in the PR (short, opinionated):

```js
// SDK v4 example: pin primary model, fallback to cheaper variant(s)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });

await client.generate({
  model: 'artemis13b@2026-03-15', // pinned version alias
  fallback: ['artemis13b-q4@2026-03-15', 'artemis13b-cpu@2026-03-15'],
  input: 'Summarize the release notes',
  options: { max_tokens: 256 },
});
```

liam: note: `fallback` is a built-in routing hint — runtime will only use it if primary is unavailable or breaching SLO. Also added example of `fallback_strategy: 'latency-first' | 'cost-first'`.

sara: love the explicit `fallback_strategy`. Please also include a short sentence about metric impact — using fallback increases token-cost variance and can affect per-route cost reporting.

liam: added that in a new paragraph and linked to the Console docs about cost breakdown.

jun: on benchmarks — the PR adds a small table but we should reference the full benchmark artifact in storage. Where is that hosted?

liam: upload link in the PR comments: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/benchmarks/2026-03-artemis-fallback.csv (internal). I added a summary line: fallback to q4 reduced median cost/token by ~40% but increased P95 latency by ~220ms on Dedicated n1 pool.

maya: is there a change required for the model registry metadata? If we add `fallback` examples people will expect `variant` labels to be authoritative.

liam: no schema change, just clarified expected labels: use `-q2`, `-q4`, `-cpu` suffixes and include `compat: { seq_ceiling: <n> }` in the model card YAML. I added a suggested YAML snippet in the PR.

sara: can docs-bot run the link checker on the PR before merge? small risk of 404 on internal S3 links.

docs-bot: Link check queued for PR #9123 — running 3 checks (external links, repo links, internal storage).

docs-bot: External links OK. Repo links OK. Internal storage link flagged: s3.redwood-inference.internal/benchmarks/2026-03-artemis-fallback.csv -> 403. Please confirm pointer or mark as internal-only.

liam: thanks — updated PR to replace public summary link and added a short CSV excerpt pasted into the PR body (so public readers get numbers). Left internal link as internal-only reference.

jun: one more thing — update the model-catalog compatibility matrix: add column `fallback-friendly` (yes/no) and note that models with substantial KV-cache sensitivity should be `no` by default.

maya: agree — that prevents accidental fallbacks for long-context LLMs. I'll file a tiny follow-up PR to the matrix after this one merges.

liam: merge checklist I added in PR body: 1) reviewer from eng-ml (jun), 2) docs review (sara), 3) quick smoke of SDK snippet in examples repo, 4) update Artemis13B model card, 5) run link-checker green.

sara: I'm on review now. quick nit: change wording from "cheaper variant" to "lower-cost variant" and rephrase the SLA sentence. Also add :thumbsup: next to the snippet if tested.

liam: done. snippet tested locally against staging and I added `:thumbsup:` in the PR notes.

docs-bot: PR #9123 link-check complete. Internal link flagged as internal-only but present. No remaining failures.

maya: awesome. I'll schedule the matrix follow-up and model-card edit after merge.

liam: thanks all — merging after Sara's final LGTM.

sara: LGTM. merging. :party_parrot:

liam: merged and backported the snippet into the quickstart repo. Created follow-up task in docs board to audit other model cards for `fallback-friendly` flag.

jun: thanks — I'll review the Artemis13B card update and sync with runtime team on KV-cache notes.

maya: filing CHANGES.md entry for the docs release notes.

liam: closing thread. If any fallout from rollout, ping #eng-runtime or open a docs follow-up.
